[[File:Golden Disk portrait.png|thumb]]
The''' Golden Disk''' is a relic introduced in November 2018.

==Description==
''Desired by both Maximals and Predacons alike, this relic is said to hold the key to the conquest of the whole Cybertron.''

==Relic Boosts==
+6% Attack and Health in Alliance Missions.

==Obtainment==
20 Relic Tickets
